sentence: This project builds a method that uses artificial intelligence to guide how atomically thin semiconductor films grow.
This project holds workshops where researchers discuss using artificial intelligence to improve cybersecurity and keeping artificial intelligence systems secure.
This project studies how bacteria make a compound called methanobactin that binds copper, and looks at the genes involved.
This project builds synthetic cells from RNA that can grow, divide and replicate their genetic information.
This project studies ways to divide objects into parts that are as similar as possible, including when the objects change over time.
This project builds an artificial intelligence tool that helps transplant centers accept or deny kidney offers and helps find hard-to-place kidneys sooner.
This project studies how one protein controls calcium signaling in nerve cells and how that affects learning.
This project uses helical laser beams to control electron dynamics in lithium atoms.
This project builds a robotic and artificial intelligence platform to find and test biodegradable polymer films with customizable properties.
This project sets up a high-performance computing cluster that speeds up data-intensive research across a campus.
This project tests whether Earth's core is the source of high helium ratios found in parts of the mantle, using experiments with metal and magma.
This project builds statistical and machine learning methods to study time series from many subjects whose dynamics are unknown and may be different.
This project builds a way for robots to find hidden fruit using a heat pulse and a thermal camera to observe how the plant cools.
This project builds ways to find and fix weaknesses in deep reinforcement learning agents that are vulnerable to adversarial attacks.
This project upgrades a field station with a multi-purpose classroom, a dry laboratory, and a kitchen and bath facility so more researchers can visit.
